subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding net worth as the true measure of wealth: assets minus liabilities
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts asset and liability cards for a sample person and calculates net worth
exercise.pictorial: Student matches income (what someone earns) to net worth (what someone has built) and shows they aren't the same thing
exercise.abstract: Student calculates net worth given a list of assets and liabilities

misconception_flags: confuses high income with high net worth, missing that spending and debt affect the real total

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
